name: Dagger
summary: −1 damage. First dagger does not take an item slot.
description: A knife or other small weapon such as a light club. Daggers have a −1 damage modifier. The first dagger carried by a figure does not take up an item slot.

name: Hand Weapon
summary: No combat modifiers. One item slot.
description: Swords, scimitars, hand axes, maces, light spears, etc. No modifiers in combat.

name: Two-Handed Weapon
summary: +2 damage. Takes two item slots.
description: Two-handed swords, battle-axes, polearms, large flails, heavy spears. +2 damage. Takes two item slots.

name: Staff
summary: −1 damage; opponent −1 damage in hand-to-hand.
description: Staffs do −1 damage and give the opponent −1 damage in hand-to-hand. Cannot be combined with a shield.

name: Bow
summary: Range 24". Load and fire as one action. Needs a quiver.
description: Load and fire as a single action. Maximum range 24". Requires a quiver.

name: Crossbow
summary: +2 damage, range 24". Separate load and fire. Needs a quiver.
description: One action to load and one to fire. +2 damage, range 24". Requires a quiver.

name: Quiver
summary: Required for bow/crossbow. One free magic ammo slot.
description: Required to shoot a bow or crossbow. May carry one magic ammunition without an extra slot.

name: Shield
summary: +1 Armour. Not with two-handed weapon or staff. No spellcasters.
description: +1 Armour. Cannot be carried with a two-handed weapon or staff. Spellcasters may not carry shields.

name: Light Armour
summary: +1 Armour. No spellcasters.
description: +1 Armour. Spellcasters may not wear light armour.

name: Heavy Armour
summary: +2 Armour, −1 Move. No spellcasters.
description: +2 Armour but −1 Move. Spellcasters may not wear heavy armour.

name: Potion
summary: Pick a specific potion in the second field.
description: Potions take one item slot. Choose the specific potion type after selecting this.

name: Scroll
summary: Pick which spell is on the scroll in the second field.
description: One-use spell scroll. Cannot be used to learn a new spell. Sale value typically 30gc.

name: Grimoire
summary: Pick which spell the grimoire teaches in the second field.
description: Used to learn a new spell. After learning, remove from the sheet. Sale 200gc if already known.

name: Javelin
summary: Hand weapon in melee, 10" thrown shooting attack. The Javelineer's issued weapon.
description: The Javelineer's standard weapon rather than a generic arms-list purchase. Functions as a hand weapon in melee (no combat modifiers) and may also be thrown up to 10" as a shooting attack, with a functionally unlimited supply.

name: Bladed Staff
summary: +1 damage; -1 to the opponent's return damage. The Monk's issued weapon.
description: The Monk's standard weapon rather than a generic arms-list purchase. Deals +1 damage in hand-to-hand and reduces the opponent's return damage by -1.

name: Throwing Knife
summary: 8" shooting attack at -1 damage; -2 damage in hand-to-hand.
description: 8" shooting attack at -1 damage; -2 damage in hand-to-hand.

name: Pistol
summary: 10" range. One-handed; doubles as a dagger. Misfire on a natural 1.
description: Black Powder Firearms (Issue 1): 10" range, one-handed, and doubles as a dagger (never unarmed; combines with a hand weapon for the usual +1 Fight bonus in Frostgrave). May carry as many as item slots allow. Like every firearm it's Inaccurate (-1 Shoot), Armour Piercing (+2 damage; also -2 Armour, min 10, within half range), Loud (natural 20 triggers a Random Encounter roll), and subject to Misfire on a natural 1 — see the Lexicon's Black Powder Firearms table for the misfire result and available upgrades (Double-barrelled, Axe-gun, Superior Craftsmanship, Silver Bullets).

name: Musket
summary: 24" range. Two-handed. Misfire on a natural 1.
description: Black Powder Firearms (Issue 1): 24" range, two-handed (only one carried, no shield). Usable in melee as a two-handed weapon but without the usual +2 damage bonus. Inaccurate, Armour Piercing, Loud, and subject to Misfire on a natural 1 — see the Lexicon's Black Powder Firearms table for the misfire result and available upgrades.

name: Blunderbuss
summary: 14" range, hits everyone within 1" of the target. Two-handed. Misfire on a natural 1.
description: Black Powder Firearms (Issue 1): 14" range, two-handed. The shooting attack hits the target and every other figure within 1" of it (a misfire on the first roll cancels the rest). Melee like a Pistol, but without the +1 Fight combo bonus. Inaccurate, Armour Piercing, Loud, and subject to Misfire on a natural 1 — see the Lexicon's Black Powder Firearms table for the misfire result and available upgrades.

name: Axe-gun
summary: Pistol/blunderbuss combo weapon; counts as a hand weapon (not dagger) in melee.
description: Black Powder Firearms (Issue 1): a Pistol or Blunderbuss fitted with an axe head, counting as a hand weapon (not a dagger) in melee instead of the usual firearm melee rule. Same range/slot cost as whichever base firearm it's built from; Inaccurate, Armour Piercing, Loud, and subject to Misfire on a natural 1 — see the Lexicon's Black Powder Firearms table.

name: Powder Horn
summary: Optional flavor for a firearm in Frostgrave; required in Ghost Archipelago.
description: Black Powder Firearms (Issue 1): not mechanically required to carry a firearm in Frostgrave, but the book's own pre-built Musketeer/Coachman/Duellist statlines include one, and Ghost Archipelago requires it (free, takes a slot) for the same firearm rules.

name: Spell Component Bag
summary: Monster Hunting (Issue 5): holds 10 more spell/potion components.
description: Monster Hunting (Issue 5): every spellcaster has a free 3-component pouch that doesn't take a slot; this bag costs 5gc and takes one item slot, but holds up to 10 more components in addition to the pouch.
